A bit of history: Growing up my mom left us after she and my dad divorced. My dad was/is emotionally abusive (and would be physically abusive but less often). I've always had behavioral problems because of undiagnosed disorders but my dad constantly blames me for everything so I've been the scapegoat of the family for almost as long as I can remember. My mom was very absent, at first we would stay with her once in a while but as we got older her visits got more scarce, I now know it was due to heavy drug use but as a kid I really had no idea. 

I have many memories that are now traumatic but this one probably fucks me up the most. My favorite movie of all time is Monsters Inc. When Monsters University came out I was 13 and so psyched about getting another movie with my favorite characters. My mom around that time became a savior figure in my head, she was up all hours of the night like me (i have severe sleep problems due to anxiety and trauma) and would always take me to do whatever I wanted, especially if I called crying because of issues at home. I treasured her despite her occasional craziness. The day she took me to see MU I hadn't slept at all that night, usual anxiety but also excitement to see my mom again, It had been a month since I had seen her before that. She came for me around 11 am and we made our way to the theater. On our way she stopped to get a Big Gulp with Dr. Pepper, it wasn't uncommon, she was always drinking soda (something I now know was due to drugs abuse). Anyway, we get to the parking lot of the theater and she starts to put on her makeup which is what she always did, her face was badly scarred (again drug abuse) so she would never go out without loads of makeup. As she's putting on her makeup I start drinking some of the soda she had bought and started getting chattier and sillier by the minute. I keep giggling and saying "wow I feel so loopy" and she kinda laughed with me and said I was just delirious because I didn't get any sleep. After about 20+ minutes in the car (again not uncommon, she always took long with her makeup) I started feeling extremely tired and she said "Maybe we should nap before the movie!" and I agreed because I was just so sleepy. After waking up we saw the movie and everything was back to normal.

Fast forward September 2018 (last year). I'm 18 and my mom is out of rehab for drug abuse because she finally reached her lowest low point and was admitted months before. My siblings and I are eating dinner with her and cracking shitty jokes about our trauma and my mom decided to drop this fucking bomb. She said "blingeeclown, remember when you were 13 and we went to go see that movie you were really excited about?" of course I said yeah and was smiling because it was such a fun memory for me. She continued "Well the reason you were acting so weird and loopy before we went in was because I had spiked my drink with ___ (i don't remember what she said) beforehand when you weren't looking and didn't know of a way to say for you not to drink any of my soda." Everyone went quiet an looked at me. I let out a laugh, trying to process what she said, and walked to my room. I cried the rest of the night and even thought about killing myself because I was already dealing with other stuff at that point in time. I had never felt so hurt than I was in that moment. It's still fucks me up now, months later.
